pattern: までもない / までもなく
aliases: made mo nai / made mo naku
purpose: Say that an action is unnecessary because the answer is obvious.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
V dictionary + までもない / までもなく
There is no need to hear that explanation.
Needless to say, safety comes first.
I know it myself, so there is no need to look it up.
formation: V dictionary + までもない / までもなく
restrictions: Often with 言う, 聞く, or 調べる.
mistake: Unlike までだ, it denies a need to act.
